evidence.title: Cobalt 1.0 is generally available — Cobalt Blog

name: Cobalt 1.0 is generally available
summary: Launch post for Cobalt 1.0, a shared workspace where coding agents build, test and hand software back to a team for review.
description: Cobalt's general-availability post traces the product from one Codex agent on a GitHub repository to a shared workspace: nine coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Grok, Muse Code, OpenCode, Pi), a persistent computer per task with previews, shared multi-repository tasks, an Agent Browser that records browser checks as evidence, Loops that start on a schedule or a repository event, and a Cobalt assistant for running and monitoring the work. Published 10 September 2026.
contains: nine coding agents supported: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Grok, Muse Code, OpenCode and Pi
each task runs on its own persistent computer with the repository and a live preview
Agent Browser follows sign-in flows, exercises forms and records browser checks as evidence
shared tasks, multi-repository changes, Azure DevOps repos and GitHub/Azure DevOps/Linear issue intake
Loops start repeatable work on a schedule or a repository event
